race.description: Drift Bar, Cafe, Restaurant @ Port City Bowling Club Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: AUTUMN HEIR (4) has had plenty of trials to be ready for this. He is bred to stay, hence kicking back off at this journey. You only need to see support and that will tell you he is ready to hit the line powerfully. D'ORO CHOICE (1) will likely be back in the field too. He got going late when resuming. Has an important gear change for this. ENDLESS APPLAUSE (5) should be strong on the line. She has not been beaten a long way this campaign. Does get a good run in transit. PRINCE IS GAME (6) might want more ground than less. The wetter the better for him. FARRAIGE (3) loves this course. Goes into all multiples.
